summary.text: Polar night happens inside the polar circles when the Sun stays below the horizon for more than 24 hours.
It lasts from 24 hours just inside the polar circles up to 179 days at the poles, and it is night in one polar region while it is day in the other.
In most cases polar night is not full darkness: sunlight bent over the horizon gives a midday twilight whose brightness depends on latitude.

items.prompt: A town sits just inside the Arctic Circle in deep winter. How long does its polar night last?
items.explain: Polar night lengthens with latitude, from 24 hours just inside the polar circles to 179 days at the poles.

items.prompt: Because the atmosphere bends sunlight, how does the length of polar day compare with polar night?

options.label: Polar night is the longer of the two
They are always exactly the same length
Polar day is the longer of the two
It depends only on the cloud cover

items.explain: Since the atmosphere refracts sunlight, polar day is longer than polar night, and polar night covers a slightly smaller area.

items.prompt: It is midwinter in northern Norway, under polar night. When is the sky at its brightest?

options.label: Around the middle of the day
At no point, it stays pitch black

items.explain: Places in polar twilight typically get their brightest light at midday, as the twilight phases build up and then fade.

items.prompt: Someone in a town with civil polar twilight wants daylight's mood benefits. Why might they still turn to a light therapy lamp?

options.label: Twilight light is the wrong colour for the eyes
Outdoor air is too cold to stand in for long
Snow blocks out most of the midday light
No stage of twilight gets bright enough

items.explain: Daylight's psychological benefits need light levels up to 10,000 lux, which no stage of twilight provides.

items.prompt: At about 80° north in midwinter, the midday Sun sits 12° to 18° below the horizon. What could you see at noon under clear skies?

options.label: Enough light to read a newspaper

items.explain: In astronomical polar twilight the midday sky is dark enough to observe point sources of light such as stars.

items.prompt: In December it is polar night inside the Arctic Circle. What is happening inside the Antarctic Circle then?
items.explain: Whenever it is night in one polar circle it is day in the other, and vice versa.
